description: A man with short dark hair, in a dark apron over a white shirt with sleeves rolled up, examines a glass bottle of dark red liquid held in both hands. Behind him and to the left is an open wooden crate packed with ice and more bottles of the same red liquid. On the table are rubber tubing with metal fittings and a folded cloth, and shelves of glass bottles and jars line the room. A lit oil lantern sits at the right edge. There are no legible letters or signature, no frame, and no visible wounds. Era cues point to the early 20th century: the rolled sleeves, apron, glass lab apparatus and lantern.
